entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A Halfling comes forth from his hiding place.*#WHITE#
You killed them all? Are we safe now? Oh, please tell me this was a bad dream!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一个半身人从他的藏身之处走了出来。*#WHITE#
你把它们全杀光了？我们现在安全了吗？噢，请告诉我这只是一场噩梦！

entries.source: Be at ease. I have dispatched those monstrosities. Do you know where they came from or what they wanted?
entries.target: 放宽心吧。我已经消灭了那些怪物。你知道它们是从哪儿来的，或者想要干什么吗？

entries.source:
From nowhere! From the sky!
I do not know. I was tending my crop just outside the town when I heard screaming. As I entered the town, I saw the dark cloud over here. Those... those... things were coming from it in blasts of lightning!
entries.target:
不知道从哪儿冒出来的！从天上！
我真不知道。我当时正在镇外照料庄稼，忽然听到了尖叫声。当我赶回镇上时，就看到了这里的这片乌云。那些……那些……鬼东西伴随着道道闪电从云里钻了出来！

entries.source: It seems they have stopped coming for now. I will look for somebody who could help dispose of this nefarious cloud.
entries.target: 看起来它们暂时不再出现了。我会寻找能够帮忙解决这片邪恶乌云的人。

entries.source:
Thank you! You have saved many people today!
I have heard of rumours of a reclusive town of wise and powerful men somewhere in the mountains. Maybe they could help? If they even exist...
There are also those Zigur-something people that claim to fight magic. Why are they not here?!
entries.target:
多谢！你今天救了很多人！
我曾听说过传闻，在群山深处的某处有一座隐秘城镇，住着智慧而强大的人。也许他们能帮上忙？如果他们真的存在的话……
还有那些叫什么伊格、自称对抗魔法的人。他们为什么不在这里？！

entries.source: You mean the Ziguranth. That would be me.
entries.target: 你是指伊格兰斯。我就是其中一员。

entries.source: I will not let you down.
entries.target: 我不会让你失望的。

entries.source: Well then please do something about this evil magic!
entries.target: 那就请一定要想办法对付这邪恶的魔法！

entries.source: I will!
entries.target: 我会的！

entries.source:
#VIOLET#*As you come out of the Dreadfell, you encounter a band of orcs*#LAST#
You! Give us the staff NOW and we might offer you a quick death!
entries.target:
#VIOLET#*当你走出恐惧王座时，遭遇了一群兽人。*#LAST#
你！立刻把法杖交出来，我们或许还能给你个痛快！

entries.source: What are you talking about?
entries.target: 你在说什么？

entries.source: Why would you want it?
entries.target: 你们为什么要它？

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#[Attack]
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#[攻击]

entries.source: Do not play dumb with Ukruk! ATTACK!
entries.target: 少在乌克鲁克面前装傻！给我上！

entries.source: That is not your concern! ATTACK!
entries.target: 这轮不到你管！给我上！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A robed Human is waiting for you when you step out of the portal.*#WHITE#
Well met, @playername@!
I am Meranas, Herald of Angolwen. I have come here at the request of King Tolak, who worried when you didn't return.
We have been watching Tannen for some time, and were pleased to see you reveal his true nature-- and stop him. For this we are grateful, and I think we can pay you back.
We have studied his portal research, and if you give me the components I will create the portal for you, here and now!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*当你走出传送门时，一个身穿长袍的人类正等候着你。*#WHITE#
幸会，@playername@！
我是梅拉纳斯，安格利文的传令官。我是应托拉克国王的请求来到这里的，由于你迟迟未归，他一直很担心。
我们观察泰恩已有很长一段时间了，很高兴看到你揭穿了他的真面目并阻止了他。我们对此深表感激，我想我们可以回报你。
我们已经分析过他的传送门研究成果，如果你把那些部件交给我，我现在就可在此为你创建传送门！

entries.source: Yes, Tannen was not exactly friendly. I thank you for your help. Here are the components. [hand him the diamond and the athame]
entries.target: 是的，泰恩确实不太友善。感谢你的帮助，这是传送门部件。[将钻石和仪式匕首交给他]

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a humanoid shape filled with 'nothing'. It seems to stare at you.*#WHITE#
I am the Eidolon and you are not welcome here!
No matter how you came to this plane, #{bold}#DO NOT COME BACK!
NOW BEGONE!
#{normal}#
.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前伫立着一个由“虚无”构成的人形轮廓。它似乎正注视着你。*#WHITE#
我是艾德隆，你在这里不受欢迎！
无论你是如何来到这个位面的，#{bold}#都不要再来！
现在离开！
#{normal}#
。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a humanoid shape filled with 'nothing'. It seems to stare at you.*#WHITE#
I have brought you here on the instant of your death. I am the Eidolon.
I have deemed you worthy of my 'interest'. I will watch your future steps with interest.
You may rest here, and when you are ready I will send you back to the material plane.
But do not abuse my help. I am not your servant, and someday I might just let you die.
As for your probable many questions, they will stay unanswered. I may help, but I am not here to explain why.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前伫立着一个由“虚无”构成的人形轮廓。它似乎正注视着你。*#WHITE#
在你死去的瞬间，我将你带到了这里。我是艾德隆。
我认定你值得引起我的“兴趣”。我将带着兴致注视你未来的脚步。
你可以在此休息，当你准备就绪，我会将你送回物质位面。
但切勿滥用我的帮助。我并非你的仆从，终有一天我或许就任由你死去。
至于你可能会有的诸多疑问，它们不会得到解答。我可以施以援手，但我不是来解释缘由的。

entries.source: Thank you. I will rest for a while.
entries.target: 谢谢你。我在此休息片刻。

entries.source: Thank you. I am ready to go back!
entries.target: 谢谢你。我已经准备好回去了！

entries.source: Thank you, but I fear I will not survive anyway, can you send me back somewhere else please?
entries.target: 谢谢你，但我恐怕回去也是难逃一死，能否请你把我送到别的地方？

entries.source: Thank you, but I fear I will not survive anyway, can you send me back somewhere else on the level please?
entries.target: 谢谢你，但我恐怕回去也是难逃一死，能否请你把我送到本层的其他地方？

entries.source: Thank you, I am ready to go back!
entries.target: 谢谢你，我已经准备好回去了！

entries.source: Thank you, but I am weary of this life, I wish no more, please let me go.
entries.target: 谢谢你，但我已厌倦了这种生活，别无所求，请让我离去吧。

entries.source:
It seems the threads of time and space have been disrupted...
I will try to send you to safety.
entries.target:
时空之线似乎已被扰乱……
我会尽力将你送到安全的地方。

entries.source: Thanks.
entries.target: 多谢。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*It seems to stare at you in weird way.*#WHITE#
I...had plans for you, but I cannot go against your free will. Know that you had a destiny waiting for you.
Are you sure?
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*它似乎正以古怪的目光注视着你。*#WHITE#
我……本对你另有打算，但我无法违背你的自由意志。要知道，本有一份宿命在等待着你。
你确定吗？

entries.source: Just let me go please.
entries.target: 请让我解脱吧。

entries.source: asked the Eidolon to let %s die in peace
entries.target: 请求艾德隆让%s安息

entries.source: her
entries.target: 她的

entries.source: him
entries.target: 他

entries.source: brought down by Eidolon
entries.target: 被艾德隆杀死

entries.source: No actually, perhaps life is still worth it!
entries.target: 不，其实或许依然值得活下去！

entries.source: You immerse your mind in the Way and let knowledge flow in.
entries.target: 你将心神沉浸于维网之中，任由知识涌入。

entries.source: [Images and knowledge flow in.]
entries.target: [图像与知识涌入脑海。]

entries.source: [You do not gain any knowledge.]
entries.target: [你没有获得任何知识。]

entries.source: You pause and recall past memories.
entries.target: 你暂停片刻，回想起往事。

entries.source: [You do not recognize anything new.]
entries.target: [你未能辨认出任何新事物。]

entries.source: Oh, hi @playername@, have you got something new to show me?
entries.target: 啊，你好，@playername@！有什么新东西要给我看吗？

entries.source: Yes, Elisa, could you have a look at these objects please? [show her the items the orb could not identify]
entries.target: 是的，埃莉萨，能否请你帮我看看这些物品？[向她展示水晶球无法鉴定的物品]

entries.source: Err, no... sorry, I just wanted to hear a friendly voice.
entries.target: 呃，没有……抱歉，我只是想听听亲切的声音。

entries.source: Not yet sorry!
entries.target: 还没呢，抱歉！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You hear something akin to a muffled giggle*#WHITE#
Oh, you are #{bold}#SOOOO#{normal}# cute!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你听到了一阵类似于掩口轻笑的声音*#WHITE#
哎呀，你真是#{bold}#太——#{normal}#可爱了！

entries.source: Goodbye, Elisa!
entries.target: 再见，埃莉萨！

entries.source:
Let's see what have you got here...
%s

That is very nice, @playername@!
entries.target:
让我看看你找到了什么好东西……
%s

真是不错，@playername@！

entries.source: Thank you, Elisa!
entries.target: 谢谢你，埃莉萨！

entries.source: Hello friend, what can I do for you?
entries.target: 你好，朋友，有什么我能为你效劳的吗？

entries.source: Could you have a look at these objects, please? [show her your unidentified items]
entries.target: 能否请你帮我看看这些物品？[向她出示你未鉴定的物品]

entries.source: Nothing, goodbye.
entries.target: 没事，再见。

entries.source:
Wait, @playername@, you seem to be quite the adventurer. Maybe we can help one another.
You see, I #{bold}#LOOOVVVEEEE#{normal}# learning new lore and finding old artifacts of power, but I am not exactly an adventurer and I would surely get killed out there.
So take this orb (#LIGHT_GREEN#*she gives you an orb of scrying*#WHITE#). You can use it to talk to me from anywhere in the world! This way you can show me your new shiny findings!
I get to see many interesting things, and you get to know what your items do. We both win! Isn't it sweet?
Oh yes, the orb will also identify mundane items for you, as long as you carry it.
entries.target:
等等，@playername@，你看起来是个相当了不起的冒险家。也许我们能互相帮助。
你看，我#{bold}#超——喜欢#{normal}#学习新的传说知识、搜寻古老强大的神器，但我自己可算不上什么冒险家，到外头去肯定会送命的。
所以拿着这颗水晶球吧（#LIGHT_GREEN#*她递给你一颗占卜水晶球*#WHITE#）。你可以在世界上的任何地方用它与我通话！这样你就能随时向我展示你新找到的闪亮宝贝了！
我能见识到许多有趣的事物，而你也能弄清楚物品的用途。我们双赢！这不是两全其美吗？
而且，只要你随身携带，这颗水晶球还会为你自动鉴定普通物品。

entries.source: Woah, thanks, Elisa. This is really nice!
entries.target: 哇，多谢你，埃莉萨。这真是太棒了！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#[Pretend to help but when it is time you will use a Ziguranth technique to make the portal fizzle. @npcname@ will be sent to Zigur to be 'dealt with' properly.]#WHITE#
Lead on; I will protect you.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#[假装提供帮助，但等到时机成熟，你将使用伊格兰斯技巧让传送门失效。@npcname@ 将被送往伊格得到“妥善”处置。]#WHITE#
带路吧，我会保护你的。

entries.source: Escort
entries.target: 护送

entries.source: Go away; I do not help filthy arcane users!
entries.target: 走开；我绝不帮助肮脏的奥术使用者！

entries.source: Lead on; I will protect you.
entries.target: 带路吧，我会保护你的。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#[Pretend to help but when it is time you will use a technique to make the portal fizzle. @npcname@ will be sent to Zigur to be 'dealt with' properly.]#WHITE#
Lead on; I will protect you.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#[假装提供帮助，但等到时机成熟，你将使用技巧让传送门失效。@npcname@ 将被送往伊格得到“妥善”处置。]#WHITE#
带路吧，我会保护你的。

entries.source: Go away; I do not care for the weak.
entries.target: 走开；我可不在乎弱者的死活。

entries.source:
At the last moment you invoke the power of nature.  The portal fizzles and transports @npcname@ to Zigur.
You can feel Nature thanking you.
entries.target:
在最后一刻，你引动了自然之力。传送门发生紊乱，将 @npcname@ 传送到了伊格。
你能感受到大自然对你的谢意。

entries.source:
Thank you, my friend. I do not think I would have survived without you.
Please let me reward you:
entries.target:
谢谢你，我的朋友。要是没有你，我想我根本活不下来。
请让我答谢你：

entries.source: There you go. Farewell!
entries.target: 拿去吧。保重！

entries.source: Thank you.
entries.target: 谢谢。

entries.source: %s grabs her amulet and disappears in a whirl of arcane energies.
entries.target: %s 抓紧她的护身符，在一阵奥术能量的漩涡中消失了。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*She lies nearly dead at your feet*#WHITE#
So, now you will kill me and complete the cycle of destruction?
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她奄奄一息地倒在你的脚边*#WHITE#
那么，现在你要杀了我，彻底完成这场毁灭的轮回吗？

entries.source: What are you talking about? Why did you attack me?
entries.target: 你在说什么？你为什么要攻击我？

entries.source: Speak and I might spare you. Why did you attack me?
entries.target: 说清楚，也许我能饶你一命。你为什么要攻击我？

entries.source: [kill her]
entries.target: [杀了她]

entries.source:
You.. you do not know?
A few hours after you entered this place a raid of orcs fell upon us. They were not alone -- demons walked among them. We were overwhelmed! Utterly destroyed!
My land is no more! All because you could not stop them at the Charred Scar! You failed us! People died to protect you, and you failed!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*She starts to weep...*#WHITE#
entries.target:
你……你不知道？
在你进入这里几个小时后，一队兽人突袭了我们。他们并非孤军奋战——恶魔与他们同行！我们寡不敌众！彻底覆灭了！
我的家园已不复存在！全都是因为你没能在灼烧之痕阻止他们！你辜负了我们！有人为保护你而死，而你却失败了！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她开始哭泣……*#WHITE#

entries.source: I know my mistakes and I intend to correct them. Please let me pass. I cannot save your people, but I can make their deaths mean something!
entries.target: 我知道自己的过错，并打算去弥补。请放我过去。我虽然无法挽救你的人民，但我能让他们的牺牲变得有意义！
